headline: Recommended denial of Peace Dale Preserve zoning amendment; approved 871 and 889 Broad Rock Road lot line change; continued Green Street Manor hearing.
summary: Members approved a lot line change between 871 and 889 Broad Rock Road. They voted to recommend that the Town Council deny the Peace Dale Preserve Special Management District zoning map and text amendment. The Green Street Manor public hearing was continued to October 27, 2026.
decisions: Approved the August 18, 2026, minutes as presented, by unanimous vote.
Approved the administrative subdivision to realign the lot line between 871 and 889 Broad Rock Road, by unanimous vote.
Continued the public hearing on the Green Street Manor preliminary plan review to Tuesday, October 27, 2026, by unanimous vote.
Recommended that the Town Council deny the Peace Dale Preserve Special Management District zoning map and text amendment, by unanimous vote.
Decided to keep October 6 as the PBWS meeting date, since Special Legal Counsel will not be available on the 15th.
Approved the Consent Agenda items, including the administrative officer's actions taken in July and August 2026, by unanimous vote.
Mr. Jordan volunteered to attend the October 14, 2026, Technical Review Committee meeting as duty member.

plain_text:
Town of South Kingstown   
Planning Board   
Regular Session Meeting Minutes 
Tuesday, September 22, 2026 at 6:30 PM   
South Kingstown Town Hall, Town Council Chambers 
180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 02879 
www.southkingstownri.gov  
Maria H. Mack, Chair 
Susan Axelrod, Vice Chair 
Elizabeth Karp, Secretary 
Paul Jordan 
Armand Monaco 
Robyn Pothier 
A. Kaiper Wilson 
 
A. Call to Order & Roll Call: 
Ms. Mack called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m. 
 
ROLL CALL: 
Present:  Susan Axelrod, Paul Jordan, Liz Karp, Armand Monaco, Robyn Pothier, Kaiper Wilson, and Maria Mack. 
Absent:  None 
 
Also Present: James Rabbitt, Director of Planning; Brian Wagner, Deputy Director of Planning; Lynn Smith, Planning 
Associate; Mark Conboy, Town Engineer; and Peter Skwirz, Special Legal Counsel. 
 
B. Approval of Minutes: 
The August 25, 2026, minutes were pulled for review and adjustment. 
The following motion was made by Mr. Jordan, duly seconded by Ms. Karp, passed unanimously. 
Motion: "The South Kingstown Planning Board hereby approves the August 18, 2026, minutes as presented." 
 
 1. PBWS Minutes - August 18, 2026 
 2. PBRS Minutes - August 25, 2026 
C. Subdivisions and Land Development Projects: 
 1. PUBLIC HEARING: 871 & 889 Broad Rock Road - Administrative Subdivision with Unified Development 
Review, located at 871 & 889 Broad Rock Road, identified as Assessor's Plat 33, Lots 11 & 12.  Applicant is 
seeking to adjust the existing lot line shared by the two (2) subject lots. TNT Real Estate Holdings, LLC, 
applicant/owner; and Kaitlyn Fratus and Daniel Cross, owners. 
Harry Miller, Professional Land Surveyor with Alpha Associates, Ltd., East Greenwich, RI, appeared to present the 
project. 
Matthew Brown, of TNT Real Estate, and Cross/Fratus owners of the two pieces of property.   
  
Discussion ensued regarding non-conforming lots; ADU on a substandard lot; and the present review is for lot line 
change, not future buildings. 
 
PUBLIC COMMENT: None 
 
The following motion, made by Mr. Jordan, duly seconded by Ms. Wilson, passed by unanimous vote. 
Motion: “The South Kingstown Planning Board hereby grants Administrative Subdivision approval to the TNT Real Estate 
Plat Administrative Subdivision, to realign the property boundary between existing parcels of land located at 871 and 
889 Broad Rock Road, owned by Kaitlyn Fratus and Daniel Cross and TNT Real Estate Holdings LLC, respectively. This 
approval is based upon the plan set titled “TNT Real Estate Plat Administrative Subdivision”, dated May 2026, revised 
7/23/2026, prepared for TNT Real Estate Holdings LLC, by Harry A. Miller, Jr., Alpha Associates, Ltd., 35 Rocky Hollow 
Road, East Greenwich, RI 02818. This approval is based upon the following Findings of Fact and Conditions of
Approval:  Findings of Fact in Regard to the Dimensional Variance 1 - 4; Findings of Fact in Regard to the Administrative 
Subdivision 5-7 and Conditions of Approval 1." 
  2. PUBLIC HEARING: Green Street Manor - Major Multi-household Land Development Project, 
Preliminary Plan Review, located at 12 Green Street, Peace Dale, Assessor's Plat 49-1, Lot 148. To 
construct two duplexes (4 units total) with associated parking and stormwater management. 
 Jonnycake Center for Hope, applicant/owner. (applicant has requested continuance to October 27, 
2026) 
The following motion, made by Ms. Wilson, duly seconded by Mr. Jordan, passed by unanimous vote. 
Motion: "The South Kingstown Planning Board hereby continues the PUBLIC HEARING: Major Multi-household Land 
Development Project, Preliminary Plan Review - Green Street Manor, to Tuesday, October 27, 2026." 
D. Recommendations to Town Council: 
 1. ZONING MAP AND TEXT AMENDMENT — "The Peace Dale Preserve Special Management District." 
 Application to amend the Town's Zoning Ordinance to create a new zoning district identified as Tax 
Assessor's Map 33, Lot 30; Property being designated for new or expanded commercial, residential and 
recreational land usage.  Applicant/owner BWJW, LLC, 371 Rose Hill Road, Wakefield, RI 02879. (continued 
from September 10, 2026, PBWS) 
Ms. Mack referenced the draft motion provided by Mr. Rabbitt to the Planning Board members. 
Mr. Jordan confirmed with Mr. Rabbitt that nothing had changed with the application since last before the Board.   
Mr. Mack suggested a change in the motion to read "deny" rather than "not approve". 
 
Discussion ensued.  The Planning Board members revised the draft motion provided by staff. 
 
The following motion, made by Ms. Axelrod, duly seconded by Ms. Wilson, passed by unanimous vote. 
Motion:  The South Kingstown Planning Board hereby votes in favor of the draft letter recommending denial, dated 
09/21/2026, to the South Kingstown Town Council, as amended at this meeting, regarding "The Peace Dale Preserve 
Special Management District - Zoning Map and Text Amendment application." 
E. Reports and Special Items: 
Mr. Rabbitt reminded the Board of the Town Council's Pulbic Hearing continuance on the Form Based Code. 
 
The following motion, made by Mr. Jordan, duly seconded by Ms. Axelrod, passed by unanimous vote. 
Motion: "The South Kingstown Planning Board hereby adds a discussion to the Agenda regarding the Form Based Code." 
The Town Council's September 14, 2026, Public Hearing on the Form Based Code was discussed.     
 
Mr. Rabbitt informed the Board that he would not be available on October 6 for the PBWS and Mr. Wagner would 
attend in his place.  The option was given to reschedule to the 15th. 
It was decided to keep the 10/6 date for PBWS, Special Legal Counsel will not be available on the 15th. 
Landscape Sub-Committee Meeting will also be held on 10/6, 5:00 or 5:30 p.m. 
 
Ms. Mack informed the Board that there is a storm water exposition that will be held in October at Roger Williams Park. 
 It is a one-day conference, something worth checking out; Mr. Rabbitt will send the invite out to the Board members. 
F. (CA) Report of Administrative Officer: Actions taken/recorded in July and August 2026, in accordance with RIGL. 
The following motion made by Mr. Jordan, duly seconded by Ms. Axelrod, passed by unanimous vote. 
Motion: "The South Kingstown Planning Board hereby approves the Consent Agenda items, as presented under Report 
of the Administrative Officer."
1. Request for Extension of Combined Master/Preliminary Plan Approval, Major Land Development Project: 
Hampton Place Full Build-Out - 4847 Tower Hill Road, Assessor's Plat 50-4, Lot 24.  Recorded July 7, 2026. 
 2. Final Plan Administrative Approval/Minor Land Development: Adaptive reuse project — 71 Old Tower Hill 
Road, Assessor's Plat 57-2 and 17 Narragansett Aven, West, Assessor's Plat 57-2, Lot 78. Recorded July 27, 
2026. 
 3. Minor Change to Approved Plan/Minor Land Development Project: 349 Main Street, Sheldon's rear entry 
stairs, Assessor's Plat 56-3, Lot 48. Recorded August 11, 2026. 
 4. Minor Change to an Approved Plan: 23 Rockland Avenue, re. hammerhead turnaround, Assessor's Plat 56-2, 
Lot 7. Recorded August 14, 2026. 
 5. Minor Subdivision, Preliminary Plan Approval: 11 Oak Dell Street, Assessor's Plat 48-3, Lot 106. Recorded 
August 21, 2026. 
 6. Minor Change to an Approved Plan: 64 Frank Avenue, re.relocation of required parking, Assessor's Plat 22-1, 
Lot 88. Recorded August 28, 2026. 
G. Designation of Duty Member for Next TRC Meeting - October 14, 2026 
Mr. Jordan volunteered to attend the October 14, 2026, Technical Review Committee meeting on October 14, 2026, at 
9:00 a.m. 
 
H. Adjournment: 
Upon Motion made by Ms. Wilson, duly seconded by Mr. Jordan, the meeting was adjourned at 7:59 p.m., by unanimous 
vote.
